name: Buzz.ai
summary: AI-powered outbound platform: prompt it and it finds intent-ready buyers, writes multichannel sequences and books the meetings — per-seat plans with monthly credit allowances and a free start.
best_for: GTM teams that want AI to run outbound end-to-end — prompt-driven prospecting of intent-ready buyers, multichannel sequences and meeting booking without adding SDR headcount
skip_if: you send low-volume, hand-crafted outreach (per-seat-plus-credits is overkill), or you're not ready to QA an AI that writes to your market on your behalf
honest_knock: Two meters run at once: seats AND credits — the seat price includes a credit allowance (500 a month on Core, 5,000 on AI Employee, read 5 September 2026), and real outbound volume means credit packages on top, so budget past the sticker. Watch the moving numbers too: the page changed twice this summer — a $75 teaser, then $79 a seat; $795 with a promised rise to $1,000, then $695 — and the $2,500 setup fee now sits on Enterprise and the white-label plans, so decide on the total for the plan you are actually offered, not the sticker. And the honest fundamental for any AI-SDR: it only books meetings as good as your list and offer, so keep a human reviewing what goes out in your name.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-09-05; Teams amounts, credits and setup fees unchanged on 2026-09-30) Teams: Core is $79 per seat a month with 500 credits a month, AI Employee $695 per seat a month with 5,000 credits; both are billed monthly and show a $0 setup fee, footnoted 'waived on prepaid annual'. Enterprise is custom: 25,000 credits a month, five seats included and a $2,500 setup fee. An 'Annual, 25% off' toggle sits above the cards, but the page kept showing the monthly figures when we switched it, so treat the annual price as unpublished until sales confirms it. A White-label tab adds Core White Label at $1,000 a month with 20 seats included, billed annually, and AI Employee White Label at $250 per seat a month billed annually with a five-seat minimum (advertised as 64% off, 'save $445 a seat'), 25,000 credits a month and a $2,500 setup fee on both. The Core card's button says 'Start for free', but the page names no free plan, no free allowance and no end date (re-read 3 October 2026), so treat it as a way to sign up, not as a free tier. History: in August 2026 the page said Core $125 (launch offer $75 for three months) and AI Employee $795 with a warning it would move to $1,000; on 2 September we read $79 and $695 and wrote that the credits were no longer stated and that one plan carried the $2,500 fee — on 5 September the credits are stated per plan and the $2,500 fee sits on Enterprise and the white-label plans, not on Core or AI Employee. On 30 September 2026 the white-label page was still titled around Core White Label at $1,000 a month; the AI Employee white-label rate renders client-side and was not re-read that day, so the $250 figure stands on the 5 September reading.
